title: Harden rules-pack record schemas by kind
description:
Replace or supplement loose unknown data payloads with kind-specific schemas for generated rules records.

Target initial kinds should include spells, creatures/monsters, classes, feats/features, actions, conditions, equipment/items, hazards, tables, and general rule text.
acceptance_criteria:
- Kind-specific schemas exist for initial supported record kinds.
- Schemas preserve enough structured data for lookup and future deterministic rules tooling.
- Invalid generated records fail validation.
- Existing minimal fixtures are either migrated or wrapped through the new schema path.
close_reason: kindSchemas.ts ships baseline + system-specific validators; existing fixtures validate, new fixtures fail loudly on missing required fields.
